actionable_findings: False negatives exceed true positives; missed-object detection is a major bottleneck.
False positives exceed true positives; the detector is producing many incorrect detections.
Matched detections have relatively strong localization (mean IoU=0.756); localization is not the primary failure bottleneck.
confidence_calibration_note: Confidence calibration here is empirical confidence behaviour and threshold sensitivity; it does not claim probabilistic calibration.

diagnostic_findings.finding: Some images contain both missed ground-truth objects and unmatched predictions.
Some predictions overlap the correct class but fall below the configured IoU matching threshold.
False-positive predictions remain at high confidence.

limitations: Failure slices are observed associations, not causal explanations.
Confidence describes model behaviour and does not prove data quality problems.
Object-size thresholds use normalized box area and are heuristic.
Audit correlation depends on the audit records exposing sample-level identifiers.
